message: Rolling player averages processed with freshness warnings on the implicit daily window.
warning: Implicit daily maintenance tolerated upstream freshness blockers. Treat this recompute as degraded until stale sources are refreshed.

executionScope.smokeTestGuidance: This run is not a one-day smoke test. Use explicit startDate=endDate for a true one-day operational probe.

progressGuidance.recommendedOperatorPath: Use explicit same-day startDate/endDate requests for smoke checks; broader browser-triggered runs should be bounded with maxPlayers.
progressGuidance.resumeStrategy: A run that reaches its runtime budget returns 207 with resume.request. The implicit daily window can also continue with continueDailyWindow=true.

dependencyContract.summary: Canonical rolling-to-FORGE dependency order for operator surfaces and preflight messaging.
dependencyContract.healthyRunRule: A healthy run requires each blocking stage to complete in order; success in a later stage does not excuse stale or skipped prerequisites.
dependencyContract.validationRule: Do not validate projections, dashboard readers, or downstream materializers until rolling_player_game_metrics, projection ingest, relationship materialization, and projection-derived tables are all fresh for the intended date window.
falseHealthySignals: A successful rolling recompute does not imply projection ingest or derived tables are current.
A successful ingest run does not imply rolling_player_game_metrics or contextual builders are fresh.
A successful downstream accuracy refresh does not imply projection_execution used healthy upstream inputs.

currentStage.label: Rolling Player Recompute
currentStage.healthyRunRequirement: rolling_player_game_metrics must be recomputed after both skater sources and contextual builders are fresh.

prerequisiteStages.label: Upstream Skater Sources
prerequisiteStages.healthyRunRequirement: NST game logs plus WGO skater game/totals tables must refresh before rolling_player_game_metrics is trusted. Support-only WGO average surfaces are not a rolling/FORGE blocker.

prerequisiteStages.label: Contextual Builders
prerequisiteStages.healthyRunRequirement: Line and power-play context must refresh before rolling outputs or projection preflight are treated as healthy.

downstreamStages.label: Projection Execution
downstreamStages.healthyRunRequirement: Goalie start priors and FORGE projections are only healthy after rolling_player_game_metrics and derived tables are fresh for the same execution window.

freshnessGate.action: Refresh stale upstream sources or use bypassFreshnessBlockers=true to override.
